analytics.title: Advanced analytics are not available yet
analytics.description: Advanced reports, cohorts, scheduled exports, and channel analytics need dedicated analytics contracts. The dashboard overview remains available for operational summaries.

billing.title: Platform billing is not available in the Seller Dashboard yet
billing.description: Subscription plans, invoices, and platform billing should be managed through a platform-level billing contract, not the store finance wallet.

carts.title: Customer carts are not available yet
carts.description: Active cart tracking and abandoned cart recovery need a dedicated Core read model before they can be shown safely in the Seller Dashboard.
carts.backlogNote: Completed orders are available now, so use the orders list for confirmed buyer activity.

customers.title: Customer directory is not available yet
customers.description: Customer profile management requires Core customer-directory contracts. The dashboard will not show guessed or order-derived customer records as a real directory.
customers.backlogNote: For now, customer details are available inside each completed order.

customersNew.title: Manual customer creation is not available yet
customersNew.description: Creating customer records from the Seller Dashboard is deferred until Core exposes customer ownership, consent, and identity-linking contracts.

payoutsNew.title: Manual payout requests are not available yet
payoutsNew.description: Payout request and bank-account verification contracts are not exposed to the Seller Dashboard yet. Available balances and settlement history remain visible in Finance.

notifications.title: Notification center is not available yet
notifications.description: In-app seller notification feeds and channel preferences are deferred until Core exposes durable notification contracts.
notifications.backlogNote: Supplier price-change and stock-change alerts should be prioritized in the follow-up notification lane.

ordersNew.title: Manual order creation is not available yet
ordersNew.description: Draft/manual order creation is not currently supported by Core. The Seller Dashboard only shows orders that came through the authenticated storefront checkout flow.
